Limits: Offline checkpoint; identity 720p transport. Not a board release, lens calibration, physical throughput or external electrical acceptance.

sensor.Limits: Real reg16_i2c with synthetic open-drain sensor register model and two full-size synthetic 2560-byte by 720-line frames per PCLK scenario. No pixel-content/DDR/UART transport, board pins, measured clocks/fps, analog PLL lock, optical calibration or physical CDC/timing acceptance. Model reset/delay timings are accelerated; production initializer delays and bus defaults remain unchanged.

capture.Limits: Synthetic full-size 1280x720 DVP at 48 MHz with HTS 1892 pixels (3784 byte clocks), VTS 740, 125 MHz core, and modeled DDR arbitration/stalls. Four complete frames and two shortened fault frames; deliberate inter-frame reservation pauses. Real capture/FIFO/DMA/write arbiter only; background result data is modeled. No sensor SCCB, electrical/CDC timing, bank-manager/remapper/scan concurrency, 720p optical calibration, board throughput or measured frame-rate claim.

control.Limits: Board startup, fault retention and LED control only. Warmup shortened to 8 ms; fixed power-on counter accelerated. Sensor/System/PLL/TX/DDR are status stubs. No SCCB, camera pixels, memory transactions, native throughput, stopped-clock recovery or physical HDMI acceptance.

output.Limits: Synthetic stress geometry/textures; no lens calibration, live DVP, capture DMA, board top, physical DDR/HDMI, timing or hardware fps acceptance. Sources preload into modeled DDR. Scan handshakes use a bench parent with the production bank manager; this is not a test of the complete camera_vga_video_system controller.

system.Limits: Synthetic two-frame sensor and DDR models; actual production system/controller/data paths at full geometry. Uses identity transport, not lens calibration. Frame boundaries can wait for source reservations. Final test-only suppression of an extra grant leaves accepted work intact. No SCCB, board startup, physical electrical timing/DDR/HDMI, clock-stop recovery or measured frame-rate claim.
